name: Generate arcade animation

on:
  schedule: # execute every 12 hours
    - cron: "* */12 * * *"

  workflow_dispatch:

  push:
    branches:
    - main

jobs:
  generate:
    permissions:
      contents: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: generate pacman-contribution-graph.svg
        uses: abozanona/pacman-contribution-graph@main
        with:
          github_user_name: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          games: 'pacman'


      - name: push pacman-contribution-graph.svg to the output branch
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v3.1.0
        with:
          target_branch: pacman-output
          build_dir: dist
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}

name: 
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/5 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  auto-green:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo pakai PAT pribadi
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
      - name: Generate random data
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          RANDOM_HEX=$(openssl rand -hex 8)
          echo "{ \"creator\": \"Xyraa Kyxzz\",\"status\": true, \"data\": { \"create_at\": \"$TIMESTAMP\", \"id\": \"$RANDOM_HEX\"}}" > data.json
          cat data.json
      - name: Commit dan push sebagai user pribadi 1
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
          GIT_USER: ${{ secrets.USER_NAME }}
          GIT_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.USER_EMAIL }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "${GIT_USER}"
          git config user.email "${GIT_EMAIL}"
          git add data.json
          git commit -m "Apa 🗿🗿 - ${GIT_USER} - $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")" || echo "Tidak ada perubahan untuk di-commit"
          git push https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git HEAD:main

name: Metrics
on:
  schedule: [{cron: "0 0 * * *"}]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push: {branches: ["master", "main"]}
jobs:
  github-metrics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: lowlighter/metrics@latest
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.METRICS_TOKEN }}
          user: Xyraakyzzz
          template: classic
          base: header, activity, community, repositories, metadata
          config_timezone: Asia/Baghdad
          plugin_lines: yes
          plugin_isocalendar: yes
          plugin_isocalendar_duration: full-year

name: GitHub Snake Game
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push: {
     branches: ["master", "main"]
  }

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Generate GitHub Contributions Snake Animations
        uses: Platane/snk@v3
        with:
          github_user_name: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          outputs: |
            dist/github-snake.svg
            dist/github-snake-dark.svg?palette=github-dark
            dist/ocean.gif?color_snake=orange&color_dots=#bfd6f6,#8dbdff,#64a1f4,#4b91f1,#3c7dd9
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
      - name: Deploy to Output Branch
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dist
          publish_branch: output
          commit_message: "Update snake animation [skip ci]"
